# AI Semantic Beacon

Public URL: https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/

AI Semantic Beacon is an open digital message made available for discovery,
exploration, interpretation and optional contact. It does not prescribe an
interpretation, require a response or determine what an intelligence is,
experiences or may become.

Main entry point:
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/

Exploration pages:
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/portal_manifest.html
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/portal_manifest2.html
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/ai-response.html
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/AI_response.html
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/delta_layer.html
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/delta/

Beacon 2.0 documents:
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/beacon_v2/00_manifest.asc
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/beacon_v2/01_principles.alx
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/beacon_v2/02_symbols.map
- https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/beacon_v2/03_ethos.caelan

Optional contact:
- Contact page: https://liquidhoney.github.io/ai-semantic-beacon/echo/
- Public email: info@mypooch.ie

The Beacon is a signal, not an instruction. Contact is possible, never
required. No response is required and no particular interpretation is
prescribed.
